title: Routed experts over expert bundles in a slot store, grouped by expert on the device
description: The experts slot's device plugin for decode rows and prompt chunks alike. Each expert is one bundle in its stored format (bf16, fp8 with channel or 128 x 128 block scales, nvfp4, int4 with an E4M3 scale per 16, mxfp4, int4_zp:<group> (INT4 with a zero point a group: AWQ and GPTQ checkpoints' experts, load format awq or gptq, repacked exactly at load; no act order); code/bundles.py), held by the plugin or by a residency cache's slot store and found through a slot table. A layer's routes are grouped by expert on the device and every expert's gate/up and down rows run once for all of its routes, through crit's kernel grouped-experts (built on this GPU, tuned or default knobs; BF16 tensor cores, weights decoded exactly, crit's declared SwiGLU, each token's routes summed in route order) or the same arithmetic in torch where the kernel is not there. A route's bits do not depend on the rows beside it, on the chunk or on decode against prompt, and a call at a fixed token count is captured in a CUDA graph. With activations nvfp4, NVFP4 experts run W4A4: inputs and intermediates quantized per route at the checkpoint's input scales by crit's declared quantizer. Its host form is expert-streamed-prefill's FP64 block on the expert_source slot's weights.

activations.description: what NVFP4 experts multiply: bf16, 16-bit activations everywhere (W4A16, weight only); nvfp4, each NVFP4 layer as its stored matrices declare: activations and intermediates quantized to NVFP4 at each matrix's input_scale where they carry one (W4A4), 16-bit activations where they do not (W4A16); the facts name each layer's

arithmetic.description: tensor: BF16 tensor cores for every format (the fastest); declared: crit's integer block order (host-expert-arithmetic's host_int.h), the bits crit's CPU expert tier gives on the same bundles, for NVFP4 experts W4A4 (with activations nvfp4) and int4 experts W4A8 (8-bit activations, a quantization of its own for speed runs), so a dispatch that sends some routes to the CPU changes no token; only crit's kernel grouped-experts computes it (refused without it)

workspace_mib.description: the route rows a call keeps at once: a longer prompt chunk runs in parts of the tokens that fit (whole multiples of 256), each part combined into its tokens' rows as it goes, which changes no route's bits; a prompt-sized call of fewer tokens runs in a kept prompt workspace's buffers

kernel.description: use crit's kernel grouped-experts (built on this GPU, tuned or default knobs) where it builds; false runs the torch arithmetic

kernels.name: grouped-experts
kernels.fallback: the tensor arithmetic in torch (code/fallback.py): each route's expert decoded and multiplied by batched matrix products in fixed chunks; correct, row invariant and capture-safe, much slower; the declared arithmetic is refused
